'''The Strip''' was a section of [[Vark Street]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Takari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]]. It contained seven [[Cantina/Legends|bars]], including [[The Giant Step]], which were known to be frequented by the [[Imperial Marines/Legends|Imperial Marines]] station on the planet.<ref name="Plant" />
